key.name: panel-gauge
key.description: How the top bar draws usage: a ring, a small bar, or no gauge at all.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Show the usage percentage next to the gauge in the top bar.

key.name: show-reset
key.description: Show, in the top bar, how long until each window shown there resets. Windows that reset together share one countdown.

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Show the icon of the source being shown (Claude, OpenRouter) before the gauge.

key.name: show-plan
key.description: Show the plan (Claude: e.g. MAX) or the money that matters (OpenRouter: the balance, else today's spend) in the top bar.

key.name: panel-windows
key.summary: Claude windows in the top bar
key.description: Which Claude usage windows the top bar shows, one gauge each, tagged "5h"/"7d"/model name when more than one is shown. Selectors: five-hour, seven-day, scoped (every per-model window), max (highest utilization), worst (the active limit closest to locking you out). Unknown selectors are ignored. Empty falls back to the first window. Other sources pick their own.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator sits in.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Where the indicator sits among the other items of its section; 0 is first.

key.name: quota-toggle-menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the menu. Empty means no shortcut. Named apart from other extensions' keys, since keybinding names are global in the shell.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to fetch usage.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON array of {id, label, configDir}, one per Claude Code profile (a directory such as ~/.claude or ~/.claude-work holding its own .credentials.json).

key.name: profiles-initialized
key.summary: Whether the profile list has been seeded
key.description: Set once auto-detection has filled "profiles" for the first time, so a list emptied on purpose is not filled again.

key.name: profile-tokens
key.description: JSON object mapping a Claude profile id to the tokens of its in-app sign-in ({accessToken, refreshToken, expiresAt}), for accounts that do not use Claude Code.

key.name: openrouter-accounts
key.description: JSON array of {id, label}, one per OpenRouter account. Their API keys are kept in the keyring under the same id, never here.

key.name: active-source
key.description: Id of the Claude profile or OpenRouter account the top bar and menu show, picked from the menu. Empty, or an id that no longer exists, shows the first source.
